title: Wood Kiln Firings (Regular Scheduled Firings)
source_quote:
Wood Firing
2026 Schedule
Wood Kiln PRICING
evidence_sentence: The wood kiln page describes regularly scheduled firings for outside potters, with pricing by cubic foot and required participation in loading, firing shifts, and unloading.
evidence_quote: Prices are by cubic foot and you're required to help with loading, firing for at least one 3-hour shift, and unloading
summary: A wood (and salt/soda) firing service available by scheduling: you bring bisque-fired pieces, pay by cubic foot ($50/cu.ft. for regular firings), attend loading and at least one 3-hour firing shift, and unload your work.
how_to_join: Contact Salvatore Annunziato at woodkiln@lancastercreativefactory.org to schedule a firing date and reserve kiln space.
cost_text: $50 per cubic foot for regularly scheduled firings through LCF; $30-35 per cubic foot for private full-kiln rentals
commitment: Loading on Saturday; firing 36–38 hours with 3-hour shifts; unloading Thursday or Saturday; flexible scheduling negotiable
bring: High-fire bisque pottery, wadded with silica sand/fire clay mix
